title: How is Hitler connected to Big Bird?
description: Five real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Big Bird from Sesame Street, through Hungary's regent, a future pope, a president and a first lady.
hook: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Big Bird?
fun_fact: At the 1970 diplomats' children's Christmas party, Pat Nixon reportedly walked the East Room with two of Big Bird's yellow feathers tucked into her diamond brooch.
research_note: Horthy's free photo with Cardinal Pacelli opens the way west; Pius XII also received the Nixons in 1957, but no free photo of that audience turned up, so the chain crosses through his 1956 audience with Harry Truman.

links.line: In 1938, Hitler hosted Hungary's regent, Admiral Miklós Horthy, for a warship launch in Kiel.

image.file: File:Horthy Miklós és Eugenio Pacelli a Keleti pályaudvaron (Képes Pesti Hírlap, 1938).jpg

links.line: In 1938, Horthy greeted Cardinal Pacelli, the future Pope Pius XII, at a Budapest train station.

image.file: File:Pius XII with Harry and Bess Truman, in the Vatican, 1956.jpg

links.line: In 1956, Pope Pius XII received former president Harry Truman and his wife Bess at the Vatican.

image.file: File:President Richard Nixon plays the piano at the Truman Library.jpg

links.line: In 1969, Truman and first lady Pat Nixon watched President Nixon play piano at the Truman Library.
And in 1970, at a White House Christmas party, Pat Nixon met Big Bird.
